title: Customer Service Automation by 2028
description: Percentage of customer service interactions fully handled by AI without human intervention. Only data points where sources directly state an automation rate are plotted.
disclaimer: Measures interaction automation, not job elimination. Actual headcount effects depend on demand response and service quality. A high automation rate may reduce headcount but does not imply equivalent job loss.

sources.title: Gartner Predicts Conversational AI Will Reduce Contact Center Agent Labor Costs by $80 Billion in 2026
The State Of Customer Service Automation
Klarna AI assistant handles two-thirds of customer service chats in first month
sources.excerpt: Klarna's AI assistant handled two-thirds of customer service chats within one month of launch — 2.3 million conversations, doing the equivalent work of 700 full-time agents.

sources.title: How AI is Transforming Customer Service
Generative AI and Customer Service: Evidence from Customer Support Interactions
sources.excerpt: AI assistance increased worker productivity by 14% on average, with greatest gains for novice and low-skilled workers.

sources.title: Gartner: By 2027, 25% of organizations will use chatbots as primary customer service channel
Teleperformance: 2024 Annual Results
sources.excerpt: Teleperformance reported full-year 2024 revenue of EUR 10,280 million. Plans to invest up to EUR 100 million in AI-focused partnerships during 2025. Over 200 new AI projects launched in 2024.

sources.title: Customer Service Job Postings Decline 18% YoY
sources.excerpt: Customer service representative postings declined 18% year-over-year. Remaining postings increasingly require technical skills and AI tool familiarity.

sources.title: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says his company has cut 4,000 customer service jobs as AI steps in
sources.publisher: Fortune (Benioff interview on The Logan Bartlett Show)
sources.excerpt: 50% are with agents, 50% are with humans. From 9,000 heads to about 5,000 because I need less heads. Support costs reduced by 17%.

sources.title: Shopify Q4 2024 Earnings — AI Customer Support Metrics
sources.excerpt: Shopify reported its AI assistant Sidekick now resolves 40% of merchant support queries without human intervention, up from 12% one year prior.

sources.title: Gartner Forecasts 20-30% of CS Agents Replaced by GenAI by 2026
sources.excerpt: Gartner projects 20-30% of customer service agents will be replaced by generative AI by end of 2026. AI adoption in CS jumped from 46% to 61% in one year.

sources.title: Zendesk AI Customer Service Statistics 2026
sources.excerpt: 95% of customer interactions projected to be AI-powered by 2028. Current AI resolution rates at leading companies exceed 55% without human escalation.

sources.title: Generative AI at Work
sources.excerpt: AI assistance increases customer service worker productivity by 15% on average. Less experienced workers improve most; AI disseminates best practices from top performers.

sources.title: Canaries in the Coal Mine? Six Facts about the Recent Employment Effects of AI
sources.excerpt: ~11% decline for early-career customer service workers; declines concentrated in roles where AI automates rather than augments tasks.

sources.title: Bank of America: Erica AI Assistant Surpasses 2 Billion Interactions
sources.excerpt: BofA's Erica AI assistant surpassed 2 billion client interactions with a 98% resolution rate. Now handles 56% of all customer inquiries without human escalation.

sources.title: Klarna Reverses Course on AI-Only Customer Service, Rehires Human Agents
sources.excerpt: Klarna reversed its AI-only CS strategy after customer satisfaction dropped 22%. CEO Siemiatkowski: 'we went too far.' Now operates hybrid model with AI handling ~66% but humans for complex cases.

sources.title: Gartner Predicts Agentic AI Will Resolve 80% of Common Customer Service Issues by 2029
sources.excerpt: Agentic AI will autonomously resolve 80% of common customer service issues by 2029. Currently only 1.6% of interactions are fully automated end-to-end.

sources.title: The Race to an Agentic Future: Customer Service Interactions
sources.excerpt: Survey of 7,950 decision-makers: 68% of all CS interactions expected to be handled by agentic AI by 2028. 56% expected within 12 months.

sources.title: The Impact of AI on E-Commerce: Field Experiments on Customer Service and Product Descriptions
sources.excerpt: AI chatbots for customer service increased sales by 16%; AI-generated product descriptions increased sales by 2.05% in field experiments.

sources.title: Measuring US workers' capacity to adapt to AI-driven job displacement
sources.excerpt: Customer service representatives get the short end of the stick in both categories [high AI exposure and low adaptive capacity].

sources.title: Incorporating AI impacts in BLS employment projections: occupational case studies
sources.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (Monthly Labor Review)
sources.excerpt: Customer service representatives, whose employment is projected to decline by 5.0 percent through 2033.

sources.title: Labor market impacts of AI: A new measure and early evidence
sources.excerpt: Customer service representatives at 70.1% observed exposure, whose main tasks we increasingly see in first-party API traffic.

sources.title: What AI Says About AI Eating Itself and the World
sources.excerpt: Customer service could see as much as 75% of interactions automated by 2026, reserving human agents for complex, nuanced cases.

sources.title: Labor Market AI Exposure: What Do We Know? (Data Repository)
sources.publisher: The Budget Lab at Yale (Gimbel, Kendall, Kulsakdinun)
sources.excerpt: Business support services (NAICS 561400) has the highest weighted industry exposure at 8.55/10, with customer service representatives at 9/10 comprising 53.8% of sector employment. Office/admin SOC group: mean 7.70/10 (range 4-9).

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence, Productivity, and the Workforce: Evidence from Corporate Executives
sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta / Duke University (Baslandze et al.)
sources.excerpt: Office and administrative support roles exhibit the most negative AI exposure (NEI 2.025), consistent with automation of routine clerical activities such as data entry. Routine clerical employment share expected to decline by 0.76pp in 2026 and 2.19pp by 2028.

sources.title: Same Storm, Different Boats: Generative AI and the Age Gradient in Hiring
sources.publisher: RATIO Institute / Örebro University (Lodefalk, Löthman, Koch, Engberg)
sources.excerpt: Customer service agents (SSYK 4222) display the same age gradient as the economy-wide canaries effect, lying between the augmentation and automation poles. All four spotlight occupations show young workers declining, older workers stable or rising.
